nodes.description: Privileged owner address of VolcanolFloki, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole access-control guard.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting sells per address, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping whitelisting addresses allowed to sell, read in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount, written by init and read by condition.
Private maximum sale amount, written by init and read by condition.
Private per-address maximum sale count, written by init and read by condition.
Whitelisted trading address, set by setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used in supply and sale scaling.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used in the ensure whitelist check.
Public payable transfer that delegates straight to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Public payable token movement; performs unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic after calling ensure.
Internal whitelist gate; recomputes the Uniswap pair, grants owner/UNI/tradeAddress exemptions and otherwise enforces condition.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit checker against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address a with data b.
Owner-only initializer writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos and mutating balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 init code hash.
Payable constructor minting total supply to the deployer and setting owner and router allowance.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership checks, allowances, balances and from-address semantics.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-influenced address, executing foreign code in contract storage context.

edges.reason: transfer._to is consumed by the transfer function body.
transfer._value is consumed by the transfer function body.
msg.sender is forwarded as _from into transferFrom by transfer.
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is compared against _from inside transferFrom.
transferFrom._from is used for allowance and balance lookups.
transferFrom._to is used for balance writes.
transferFrom._value drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping whose value is decremented without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw arithmetic.
_from selects the balance decremented with raw subtraction.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] with raw arithmetic.
_to selects the balance incremented with raw addition.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before moving funds.
ensure._from is checked against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale.
ensure._to is compared against owner for exemption.
ensure._value is forwarded into condition.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)).
condition._from is used to read _onSaleNum limits.
condition._value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
approve._spender is the key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
approve._value is written into allowance.
msg.sender is the owner key used when approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing the delegatecall.
delegate.a is the target address supplied to delegatecall.
delegate.b is the calldata supplied to delegatecall.
Arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-influenced address a executes untrusted code that can re-enter the contract with its storage.
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
init.saleNum is assigned to _saleNum.
init.token is scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale.
init.maxToken is scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale.
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend._tos supplies the recipient array iterated over.
batchSend._value is the per-recipient amount.
_tos.length multiplies _value in an unchecked multiplication.
_value multiplies _tos.length in an unchecked multiplication.
total feeds the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] subtraction.
Loop index i selects the current recipient from _tos into local _to.
Loop recipient _to is credited with raw addition in the batchSend loop.
batchSend loop executes the balance credit for each recipient.
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress.addr is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress mutates the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
pairFor.factory participates in the CREATE2 address computation.
pairFor.tokenA participates in the pair derivation.
pairFor.tokenB participates in the pair derivation.
ensure calls pairFor to recompute the expected Uniswap pair address.
Local token0 is hashed into the pair address.
Local token1 is hashed into the pair address.
constructor._name is assigned to name.
constructor._symbol is assigned to symbol.
constructor._supply is scaled into totalSupply.
msg.sender becomes the owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
Constructor initializes the owner privilege used by all restricted functions.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
Constructor grants the router an unlimited allowance.
Constructor sets totalSupply.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum for the sender.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist exemption.
ensure compares _from with tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from with the UNI constant.
owner address grants an unconditional exemption in ensure.
owner guard protects the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
owner guard protects the init setter.
owner guard protects batchSend.
owner guard protects setTradeAddress.
condition reads _minSale for the minimum sale check.
condition reads _maxSale for the maximum sale check.
condition reads _saleNum for the per-address sale count check.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
Local _UNI computed in ensure is used for the whitelist comparison.
Local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
